about: Address rules (User [ref]/[ref], toolkit [ref]). (1) 'mentions': the @handles a line ADDRESSES, i.e. those left after code (fenced and `inline`) and quoted text ("..." and curly quotes) are removed, lowercased, in order, with the page's mention shape /(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.@-])@([A-Za-z0-9]+(?:-[A-Za-z0-9]+)*)/g. (2) 'alias': convertUserAlias(text, handle): every @user outside code and quotes becomes @<handle>. Quote rules: a straight double quote opens only at the start of the text or after whitespace or ( [ {, so 5" pipe is not a quote; it closes at the first double quote followed by the end, whitespace or . , ; : ! ? ) ] }; curly quotes open at U+201C and close at the next U+201D; a span is at most 400 characters and never crosses a newline; an unmatched quote is left alone; apostrophes never count. The engine (src/server/room-commands.ts) and the Workbench copy must agree on every case. Newlines are written as \n.

mentions.name: a quoted word, then an address
unmatched opening quote leaves the text alone
a closing quote must be followed by space or punctuation
two quoted spans and two addresses
a closing quote before a full stop
a curly quote inside a straight one
a quote never crosses a newline
an address after a quote on the next line
an email is not a mention
